selected_evidence.requirement: Record sudo commands with user and timestamp in `/var/log/sudo-commands.log`
selected_evidence.summary: The configuration parsed successfully, and the dedicated log captured the test command with year-bearing timestamp, invoking user `root`, target user, working directory, and command.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep sudo command entries out of the general system log
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, unique sudo-command markers were absent from both `/var/log/messages` and `/var/log/secure`.

Evidence captures the healthy baseline, accepted reboot schedule, temporary disconnection, changed boot ID, active/enabled rsyslog, valid persistent sudoers configuration, preserved pre-reboot record, and successful post-reboot command logging.
